deadline.value: The page gives no application deadline; a decision on acceptance typically takes about 6 weeks.

gre_subject.value: The page does not mention a GRE Subject test; no Mechanical Engineering subject test exists.

supervisor.value: Acceptance needs a doctoral agreement with the supervisor and KHYS registration.
supervisor.quote: Application for acceptance as a doctoral candidate required: Doctoral agreement and registration with KHYS

funding.value: The page does not say how doctoral candidates are funded.

entry_route.value: Admission requires a master's degree program, a four-year university degree, or a degree built on an undergraduate program, with an above-average result.
entry_route.quote: a degree program at a university or university of teacher education with a standard period of study of at least four years

notes: Based on the 2017 Doctoral Degree Regulations for Mechanical Engineering. Above-average degree means a grade of 'very good' (1.5) or better, or the equivalent ECTS grade.
